title: Mars 2055
description:
Loneliness is the only feeling you may ever know? You wake up alone on a planet that appears to be Mars. There are no instructions. There is no help. There is only the suit on your back and the silence of a dead world. Finding your way home is the goal, but staying alive is the challenge.

Join the MissionJoin over 10,000 survivors who have already braved the Red Planet.

Rated 4.3/5 on mobile!

Fully playable on Steam Deck and supports Xbox Controllers.

Survive, Repair, and EscapeMars 2055 is a first-person solo adventure where environmental storytelling meets complex problem-solving. In this desolate sandbox, you aren't just a passenger—you are the technician, the detective, and the survivor.

Key Features

• Environmental Mystery: Search for clues left behind by those who came before—be they human or artificial.

• Repair & Restore: Fix broken equipment and restore damaged systems to regain control of the base.

• Secure Access: Use your findings to bypass security and access locked sectors.

• MacGyver Mechanics: Combine seemingly unrelated items into usable modules to overcome obstacles.

• High-Stakes Sandbox: Move carefully; a single miscalculation could destroy the entire base.

"Where does the adventure come from? It comes from the stories you tell yourself, alone, inside your head."
description_short: A first-person solo survival adventure set on a desolate Martian base. Search for clues, repair critical systems, and solve complex environmental puzzles to find a way home before your life support—or your luck—runs out.
